spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the spec algorithm's terminal-state line verbatim (failed rejects InvalidStateError; closed resolves with the most recent stats), quoting the normative step and running each branch against a real session.

interactive.rationale: Two independent runs with timestamped step logs and verbatim settled outcomes; the clean-close branch takes a user-editable endpoint.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the sharp closed-vs-failed line with the failed branch running anywhere; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-WebTransport, method-missing, constructor-throw, ready timeout, the unexpected-resolution branch, and the clean-close branch degrading honestly into a second failed-branch demonstration when the network blocks QUIC.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 and the getStats() terminal-state spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts both InvalidStateError contracts this page demonstrates; 6/6 flagged / 0/6 unflagged verified on the live /conformance/ route.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright-driven CDP; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, unflagged and behind WebTransportStats. Flagged: the failed branch rejected InvalidStateError 'Cannot retreive stats on a failed connection.' and the clean-close branch honestly reported falling back to the failed branch when the handshake could not complete. The genuinely-closed-resolves outcome needs a reachable endpoint and remains unverified here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts failed-rejects, closed-resolves (when reachable), close-branch-blocked, and the fallback branches; console prefixed [wt-stats:terminal].

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; rejected/resolved result colours on near-white stone at AA; buttons overriding background set color.

accessibility.rationale: Each branch is its own labelled section with a native button, step logs and results are aria-live=polite, outcomes lead with words not colour.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports screenshotted and overflow-checked; single-column stages reflow cleanly at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the closed-resolves post-mortem on a reachable endpoint
openQuestions.detail: From an unproxied network on a 159-class build, run branch 2 against echo.webtransport.day:4433 and confirm getStats() resolves after close()/closed with a stats object (and note which members Chromium includes in the post-mortem snapshot).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Async outcomes belong in polite live regions with text-first state words.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Step logs and both result lines are aria-live=polite and lead with 'rejected:'/'resolved with'.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column stages with overflow-wrap for long error strings at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result lines use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px DPR3.

summary: The closed-resolves vs failed-rejects contract as two real runs; the failed branch is fully verified on flagged Chromium 153 and the clean-close branch degrades honestly where QUIC is blocked.
